name: CreateResourceShare

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource share.

The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

It can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元名称。

长度范围：1~50个字符。

格式：允许输入英文字母、数字、中文、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: resource_share_name

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the shared resource.

You can add up to five shared resources at a time.

> Specify the `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` parameters in pairs
element_fields.help_zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

> `Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置
element_fields.name: resource_id

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

You can add up to five shared resources at a time.

For a list of supported resource types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html.

> Specify the `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` parameters in pairs
element_fields.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html。

> `Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置
element_fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Names (ARNs) of the shared resources.

You can add up to five shared resources at a time
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_arns

parameters.help_en: The name of the permission. If unspecified, the system attaches the default permission for the resource type. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.help_zh: 共享权限名称。为空时，系统自动绑定资源类型关联的默认权限。具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.name: permission_names

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow sharing with accounts outside your resource directory. Valid values:

- `false` (default): Resources can be shared only with accounts within your resource directory.

- `true`: Resources can be shared with any Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许共享给资源目录外的账号。取值：

- false（默认值）：仅允许资源目录内共享。
- true：允许共享给任意账号
parameters.name: allow_external_targets

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The property of the principal. For example, you can specify a time range for resource sharing. Valid values for `timeRangeType`:

- `timeRange`: a specified time range.

- `day`: the entire day.

> Specify the `TargetProperties.N.TargetId` and `TargetProperties.N.Property` parameters in pairs
element_fields.help_zh:
资源使用者属性参数。例如：您可以设置资源共享的时间段。`timeRangeType`取值：
- timeRange：指定时间段。
- day：全天。
> `TargetProperties.N.TargetId`与`TargetProperties.N.Property`成对出现，需要同时设置
element_fields.name: property

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the principal.

> Specify the `TargetProperties.N.TargetId` and `TargetProperties.N.Property` parameters in pairs
element_fields.help_zh:
资源使用者ID。

> `TargetProperties.N.TargetId`与`TargetProperties.N.Property`成对出现，需要同时设置
element_fields.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the principal.

> This parameter is available only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
资源使用者属性。
> 仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时可以设置该参数
parameters.name: target_properties

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key.

> The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。
> 最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value.

> The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签值。
> 最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value
